nodes.long_description:
1.Use the forceps for weighing
2.Prepare the espresso machine for brewing
3.Use an espresso machine to make a shot
4.Use espresso to make an Americano
5.Use espresso to make a café latte
6.Use espresso to make an iced Americano 
7.Use the espresso process to make an iced caffe latte
nodes.short_description:
Work in a virtual reality cafe and brew espresso for an Americano,
Iced Americano, Caffe Latte, etc. by repeatedly making and mastering them and becoming a barista 
Improves job performance and provides hand tracking for people with disabilities who have difficulty using controllers.
 Hand tracking is also available 
Barista content created to make the game possible through hand tracking

nodes.long_description: Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual experiments in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and materials, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of science in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
